# ts-ioc-container

> Platform-agnostic TypeScript AOP platform for building system engines and meta-frameworks, on a dependency injection container (frontend, backend, workers, scripts): scoped lifecycles, decorators (`@register`, `@inject`, `@hook`), typed tokens, lazy dependencies, provider pipes, transparent proxies for middleware pipelines and AOP. The README is a living cookbook: every example is an executed test. Plus React bindings in `@ts-ioc-container/react`, the `tic` build-time bundler in `@ts-ioc-container/bundler`, and OpenAPI code generation in `@ts-ioc-container/openapi-to-server` and `@ts-ioc-container/openapi-to-zod`. The API changes between majors: prefer the `AGENTS.md` shipped in the installed package (`node_modules/ts-ioc-container/AGENTS.md`) over memory.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md (core)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/ts-ioc-container/AGENTS.md): setup, recipes, pitfalls, removed APIs, error codes
- [README (core)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/ts-ioc-container/README.md): full documentation with executable examples
- [Cookbook](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/ts-ioc-container/README.md#cookbook): complete architectures (mediator / middleware pipeline, declarative action pipeline, error bubbling through scopes, retry later, unit of work per request, layer and scope decorators, per-request scope, frontend widget scope, background worker), each one a test
- [Meta-framework engine](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/ts-ioc-container/README.md#meta-framework-engine): building your own framework, middleware pipeline or agent runtime on the container
- [AGENTS.md (react)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/react/AGENTS.md): React bindings
- [AGENTS.md (bundler)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/bundler/AGENTS.md): `tic build` — bundles your dependencies into a single container module, from folders / tsconfig aliases
- [AGENTS.md (openapi-to-server)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/openapi-to-server/AGENTS.md): TypeScript server interfaces from OpenAPI 3.0 specs
- [AGENTS.md (openapi-to-zod)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/openapi-to-zod/AGENTS.md): Zod validation schemas from OpenAPI 3.0 specs

- [Architect skill (Claude Code)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/ts-ioc-container/skills/ts-ioc-container-architect/SKILL.md): picks the cookbook pattern for a task and applies the design rules; `/plugin install ts-ioc-container --marketplace IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container`
